reuse.why: Adds one assertBankAccountNotLinked helper and calls it from every provider's link function; no existing helper is bypassed.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the one-line guard call is repeated in the five link functions, as the tree's per-provider structure requires.

placement.why: The guard sits in server/accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers and runs before any bank, account or sync side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear, single definition of 'linked'; small nit that syncSource is typed as string rather than AccountSyncSource, and a future provider must remember to add the call.

one_place.where: server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu and enableBanking link functions
